title: Operationally induced preferred basis in unitary quantum mechanics
summary: The preferred-basis problem and the definite-outcome aspect of the measurement problem persist even when the detector is modeled unitarily. Experimental data are represented in a Boolean event algebra of mutually exclusive records, while the theoretical description employs a noncommutative operator algebra with continuous unitary symmetry. This change of mathematical structure constitutes the core of the ``cut'': a necessary interface from group-based kinematics to set-based counting.
